decisive_items: Regular, narrow complex tachycardia with rate of 170 beats/min
Superiorly directed P waves (negative in leads II, III, and aVF)
Long RP interval (RP interval > PR interval)
response.rationale: The ECG findings are diagnostic of atrial tachycardia, whereas COVID-19 pneumonia is a concurrent infection but does not explain the arrhythmia.

rejected.why: Does not account for the specific ECG pattern of regular narrow complex tachycardia with superiorly directed P waves and long RP interval.
